results.name: Lollipop Array
results.description:
# Lollipop Array
A full spectrum suite of lollipops created for the Sketchfab Weekly Challenge *'Sweets'* theme.

These are the kind that can either crack into shards or melt away slowly per your style of eating them. The centers could be anything from Tootsie Roll, to licorice, bubble gum, or any variety of sweet sealed within the candy shell.

An added bonus is that the Cherry, Blueberry, and Grape flavors will leave the majority of your tongue that color for 12 hours or more.

Our collection of lollipops will delight you with a variety of flavors and colors. From classic fruity flavors to unusual flavor experiments, we have a lollipop to suit every taste and preference. Each lollipop is a little piece of joy that will make your day a little brighter and tastier.
